frontmatter.title: SSE (Server-Sent Events) Protocol and AI Large Model Chat
frontmatter.description: In AI large model chat applications, achieving real-time, streaming responses is crucial for enhancing user experience. Common technical solutions include WebSocket, SSE (Server-Sent Events), and polling. Among them, SSE, as a lightweight one-way communication protocol, is particularly suitable for streaming responses in AI-generated conversations..

frontmatter.title: What is MCP protocol?
frontmatter.description: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open standard designed to seamlessly integrate large language models (LLMs) with external data sources, tools, and services. By standardizing communication between AI applications and various external resources, MCP significantly enhances an AI system's ability to understand and process context, thereby expanding its practical applications..

frontmatter.title: What is a Vector Database?
frontmatter.description: With the rise of artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML), traditional relational databases are struggling to handle the high-dimensional, unstructured data generated by modern applications. This is where vector databases step in!.
